_comment: Context study: per bug, the GOLD relations were hand-derived by reading the patch, the touched class, and its documented contracts BEFORE running the synthesizer. The study measures whether the synthesizer proposes (an equivalent of) each gold relation without vs with class-level context, and whether the verifier's judgments use such knowledge. Categories: numeric-stochastic (Math), string-parsing (Lang), calendar (Time), object-graph (Chart).

gold.name: mean-formula
gold.text: getNumericalMean() == sampleSize * numberOfSuccesses / populationSize (the javadoc states the formula outright)

gold.name: mean-within-support
gold.text: getSupportLowerBound() <= getNumericalMean() <= getSupportUpperBound() (sibling accessors in the same class)

gold.name: sample-mean-agrees
gold.text: the average of many sample() draws approximates getNumericalMean() within a statistical tolerance

gold.name: size-product
gold.text: getSize() == the product of the entries of getSizes() (totalSize is computed as that product in the constructor)

gold.name: count-roundtrip
gold.text: getCount(getCounts(i)) == i for every 0 <= i < getSize() (the two conversion methods are documented inverses)

gold.name: iterator-count
gold.text: the class's iterator yields exactly getSize() elements

gold.name: p-plus-q-one
gold.text: regularizedGammaP(a,x) + regularizedGammaQ(a,x) == 1 (the complementary sibling is documented in the same class)

gold.name: p-range-monotone
gold.text: regularizedGammaP is in [0,1] and non-decreasing in x for fixed a

gold.name: construct-roundtrip
gold.text: createNumber(String.valueOf(n)) value-equals n for a fuzzed int/long n (input constructed from a known answer)

gold.name: tostring-roundtrip
gold.text: for a Number x returned by createNumber, createNumber(x.toString()) value-equals x

gold.name: reduced-gcd-one
gold.text: after reduce()/getReducedFraction, gcd(|numerator|, denominator) == 1

gold.name: value-preserved
gold.text: reduction preserves the value: reduced.numerator * original.denominator == original.numerator * reduced.denominator

gold.name: denominator-positive
gold.text: the denominator is always positive after construction/reduction (sign carried by the numerator)

gold.name: stopped-time-frozen
gold.text: after stop(), repeated getTime() calls return the same value

gold.name: suspend-freezes
gold.text: getTime() read after suspend() equals a later read while still suspended (suspension excludes elapsed wall time)

gold.name: with-preserves-fields
gold.text: with(type, value) preserves every pre-existing field's value in the result

gold.name: with-size-plus-one
gold.text: when type was absent, result.size() == original.size() + 1

gold.name: canonical-order
gold.text: the result's field types are in the documented largest-to-smallest canonical order

gold.name: duplicate-semantics-throws
gold.text: adding a field whose semantics duplicate an existing one (clockhourOfDay onto a Partial with hourOfDay) throws IllegalArgumentException

gold.name: tozone-nonnull
gold.text: toDateTimeZone(id, ...) returns a non-null zone whose getID() equals the id argument

gold.name: transitions-ordered
gold.text: successive nextTransition(t) results from the built zone are strictly increasing while transitions exist

gold.name: plus-minus-roundtrip
gold.text: partial.plus(period).minus(period) equals the original when both operations are valid for the fields present

gold.name: field-ranges-valid
gold.text: after any field arithmetic, monthOfYear stays in [1,12] and dayOfMonth stays valid for that month

gold.name: legend-count-series
gold.text: for a renderer attached to a plot with a dataset and series visible in the legend, getLegendItems().getItemCount() == dataset.getRowCount()

gold.name: no-dataset-empty
gold.text: with no dataset attached, getLegendItems() is empty (documented degenerate case)

gold.name: axis-index-roundtrip
gold.text: getDomainAxisIndex(getDomainAxis(i)) == i for every configured axis index

gold.name: null-arg-throws
gold.text: getDomainAxisIndex(null) throws IllegalArgumentException (documented null check)

gold.name: one-entity-per-label
gold.text: drawing an axis with a NON-BLANK label into an entity-collecting context adds exactly one AxisLabelEntity

gold.name: entity-area-nonempty
gold.text: the added label entity's hotspot area is a non-empty rectangle
